svg.title: Architectural drawing
svg.desc: Elevation of an arched church doorway with its semicircular panel marked, and a round close-up of that tympanum showing its carved relief: a central figure in an almond shape, rays, symbols in the corners and a row of small figures above the lintel. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
svg.text: SOURCE: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard
geometric construction of this form; no external drawing
